# What to bring to an auto repair appointment in Albuquerque

A practical checklist for describing the problem, reviewing an estimate and planning your drop-off at TEC PRO Auto Care.

AR Albuquerque Auto Repair Repair planning · 2 min read

You do not need to know which part has failed before calling a mechanic. A clear account of the problem, a few vehicle details and your recent service records can make the first appointment more useful.

## Write down what changed

Describe what you noticed in ordinary words: a slow start, a new sound, a warning message or a change in how the car drives. Include when it happens and when it began. If a dashboard message disappears, a photo taken while safely parked can preserve it. Do not drive the vehicle just to recreate a concern that affects safe operation.

## Bring the vehicle history you have

Have the year, make, model and mileage ready. Recent invoices show what has already been serviced, while an earlier estimate can show what another shop recommended. Missing records are useful context too: tell the shop what is uncertain. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

THE PERFECT START TO A CUSTOMER JOURNEY

01 - A WARM WELCOME  
Offer a comfortable, clean and tidy customer reception with friendly staff. This tells your customers that you are professional and deliver a high standard of work. Consider providing a TV, complimentary hot drinks, water and free Wi-Fi to keep your waiting customer happy.

02 - ASK ALL THE RIGHT QUESTIONS  
Gather as much information as possible about the customer (name, contact details), the vehicle (registration number and history), the job (what needs to be done) and other necessary details (e.g. regarding the guarantee or insurance), and suggest a time frame for performing the work. This enables you to:  
• Connect with the customer.  
• Make it quicker and easier for the mechanic to solve problems.  
• Deliver a fast, efficient repair that pleases the customer.

03 - OFFER AN ADDED BENEFIT  
A free add-on service is sure to please your customer, so why not offer a complimentary Vehicle Health Check? This will give customers peace of mind and highlight any issues that they may not be aware of.

# What to tell us before we arrive

Not sure what to say? This simple checklist helps you prepare before you call. You don’t need every detail — share what you can and we’ll ask the rest.

## What to tell us

These are the details that help us understand the job quickly. Go through the list and include what applies to your situation.

### Where the car is

A street, area or landmark so we know where to head to.

### Make and model

For example, a Ford Fiesta or Vauxhall Corsa — and the year if you know it.

### Whether it starts

Does it crank, click, or do nothing at all? This is one of the most useful things to know.

### What happened

Did it stop suddenly, fail to start this morning, or develop a problem while driving?

### Sounds

Clicking, grinding, squealing, knocking, whining — or no sound at all. What do you hear when you try to start it?

### Warning lights

Which lights are on — engine management, battery, ABS, temperature, oil? A photo really helps.

### Smells or leaks

A burning smell, a sweet coolant smell, or fluid underneath? --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
